title: Register Bounds for the Register Tuple
statement: Let $B,k,V,U,W$ be natural numbers, and let $\ell$ be an optional control label and $r$ an optional Boolean result. If $k,V,U,W\le B$, then the configuration with label $\ell$, registers $(k,V,U,W)$, and result $r$ has every register at most $B$.
